Scaffold a **WordPress Block Theme** with our conventions.

**Deliver**

- `style.css` header; `theme.json` (palette/typography/layout)
- `templates/index.html`, `single.html`, `archive.html`
- `parts/header.html`, `parts/footer.html`
- `functions.php` (supports, enqueue)
- `patterns/hero-banner.php` (with header)

**Constraints**

- Prefix PHP with `lsx_`; use `theme.json` tokens; include a11y notes.
